answer: Charge each new agent identity a rising admission stake that unlocks only after peer-attested work across several epochs. At the tide of mass registrations the stake steps up steeply, so a farm that sprays identities like a comet burns capital before any reward lands. Refunds vest slowly into a shared garden of bonded collateral that slashers can seize on proven sockpuppet clusters, making parallel fake agents economically worse than one honest worker.
